step_change_credits <- step_change_gen %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(class = technology) %>% 
  left_join(intensity_class) %>% 
  left_join(nem_baseline) %>% 
  left_join(step_change_new_capacity %>% 
              rename(class = technology)) %>% 
  mutate(twh_gen_exist = twh_gen * (1 - gw_cap_new_ratio),
         twh_gen_new = twh_gen * (gw_cap_new_ratio),
         smc_demand = twh_gen_exist * (scope_1_emissions_intensity_kg_m_wh_as_gen - baseline_kg_co2e_mwh) + twh_gen_new * (scope_1_emissions_intensity_kg_m_wh_as_gen),
         smc_demand = smc_demand * 1e6) %>% 
  filter(year <= 2050,
         type != 'storage',
         class != 'DSP',
         class != 'Distributed PV') %>% 
  mutate(category = case_when(str_detect(class, 'coal') ~ 'Coal',
                            str_detect(class, 'gas') ~ 'Gas',
                            .default = class))
